scripts.test: jest --runInBand && echo Business rule: create, approve, assign, claim, and resolve a ticket, with unauthorized resolution rejected. SQLite integration: ticket status and audit event were saved and read back. API E2E: employee creation succeeded, employee approval returned 403, Helpdesk approval succeeded, and invalid input returned 400. These tests protect the original workflow from regressions.
scripts.test:integration: jest --runInBand --runTestsByPath src/tickets/tickets.integration.spec.ts && echo Integration steps: opened a real temporary SQLite database, created a ticket through TicketsService, read it back through TypeORM, and confirmed its Pending Helpdesk Review status and TICKET_SUBMITTED audit event were persisted.
scripts.test:e2e: jest --runInBand --runTestsByPath src/tickets/tickets.e2e.spec.ts && echo E2E steps: sent real HTTP requests to a NestJS app backed by SQLite; employee-1 created a ticket, employee-1 was denied approval with 403, helpdesk-1 approved it with 201, and a request missing required fields was rejected with 400.
